meaning:
1) dryness, drought, heat
1a) dryness
1b) drought
1c) parching heat

elsewhere.note: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.
behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew on the fleece only, and it is dry on all the ground, then I’ll know that you will…
My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.
Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: “He will have no one to sit on David’s throne. His dead body will be cast out in the day to the heat…
